user.title: Energy settlement
user.description: Choose the meters this metering point is settled on. Prices and contract terms can be edited afterwards.

data_description.import_entity: A cumulative kWh sensor, not a power sensor.
data_description.export_entity: Leave empty if there is no generation.

data_description.allowance_basis: Whether the allowance is spent by everything withdrawn, or only by what is left after generation is netted off. The two differ sharply for a household that both draws and generates a lot.
data_description.mode: Szaldó nets generation against consumption. It closes ten years after commissioning, after which settlement is gross.

prices.title: Prices
prices.description: Set the prices in force from a chosen day. Leave the date at today for a change from now, or set it back to correct something noticed late. Prices already effective on that day are replaced.

data_description.feed_in: Paid for generation that netting cannot absorb. Typically a fraction of the price the same kWh costs to buy.

remove_price.title: Remove a price change
remove_price.description: Drops a price change added with the wrong date.

close_settlement.name: Close settlement period
close_settlement.description: Starts a new settlement period on the day the meter was read. The boundary follows the reading, not the calendar.

seed_period.name: Seed the settlement period
seed_period.description: Adopts a settlement period already under way, so an integration installed mid-period does not account from zero. Take the figures from your last invoice and current meter.

period_start.name: Period start
period_start.description: The date of the last meter reading.

exported_kwh.name: Exported so far
exported_kwh.description: kWh fed in since that reading.

import_invoice.name: Import a settled invoice
import_invoice.description: Records a past settlement as long-term statistics, so previous years appear in history instead of the story starting today.

exported_kwh.name: Exported
exported_kwh.description: kWh fed in over the period.

price_coverage.title: No prices for the start of the settlement period
price_coverage.description: The price schedule does not reach back to {period_start}, when the current settlement period began, so the energy already recorded cannot be valued. Add a price change effective on or before that date.

settlement_overdue.title: Settlement period has run {days} days
settlement_overdue.description: A settlement period this long suggests the meter has been read without the integration being told. Call the Close settlement period action with the reading date to start the next one.

source_missing.title: Energy source sensors are not reporting
source_missing.description: {entities} are unavailable or not numeric. Nothing is being recorded from them, and the settlement will understate what the house used.
